integrity: The general claim is supported by the explicit radical-unit orbit proof; finite enumerations provide independent small-parameter checks, not infinite certification. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite-dimensional split basic algebras over finite fields. It identifies the entire clique polynomial but not graph isomorphism. The complete full text of a potentially related triangular idempotent article was not available; equivalent general conjugacy-based enumerations in other literature remain a risk. Finite checks are not a proof.
title: Radical-multiplication blindness of the complete commuting-idempotent clique polynomial
